conditions.raw_text: All landholding farmer families who hold cultivable land in their names as per state land records are eligible
hold cultivable land in their names as per state land records

documents.raw_text: active Bank Passbook details linked with Aadhaar

benefits.raw_text: The beneficiary family will receive an income support benefit of Rs. 6000 per annum, paid in three equal installments of Rs. 2000 every four months

exclusions.raw_text: Farmer families where one or more members hold or held constitutional posts
Former and present Members of Parliament (Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha), Members of Legislative Assemblies or Councils
Former or retired officers and employees of central/state government ministries or departments
All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, and Chartered Accountants registered with professional bodies
